response.title: A Plan for the Community Garden
response.passage: When a dry spring caused a shortage of water at the community garden, the volunteers met to make a plan. They agreed to cooperate by taking turns carrying water from a nearby well. Each team would reserve one bucket for the youngest plants, which needed extra care. Before watering, volunteers would observe the soil to see which beds were driest. They chose Maya to record the amount used because her notes had always been reliable. By sharing the work and checking the soil first, the group hoped to keep every plant alive until the rain returned.
